Methods that return a boolean should use an `is_` prefix instead of `get_`:

```suggestion
		<method name="is_joy_accelerometer_enabled" qualifiers="const">
```
Invalid parameters should print an error with `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG()` instead of failing silently. (Same for all other adaptive trigger methods.)
